proposals.judgment: Verbatim third-party notices are data under their original licenses, not a first-party relicensing action. Exempt only exact declared notice bundles after a separately reviewed catalog pin, manifest and complete snapshot identities pass. Retain first-party grant checks, undeclared-file rejection, bounds and link protection.
proposals.boundary: Never infer or refresh the policy pin from suspect bytes; identity alone does not prove actual dependency completeness or legal compatibility. Future candidate inventory must bind the selected policy, catalog and checker dependencies.
